bibliographic.title: Office Temptation
bibliographic.author: HHRichards
bibliographic.description:
Chat with your bubbly coworker Maddie at work. She is tempted by a sweet treat. Help her prevent temptation for some sexy photos, or let her indulge for a sexy treat. This interactive story has 2 endings!

This is a short introduction to Lewd Mod 2, which has a lot more images & a lot more chatting with Maddie & other characters.

Get the full game here: https://hhrichards.itch.io/lewd-mod
